PreInvocation.command: bash -c 'r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && exec bash "$r/with_jev_key.sh" python3 "$r/skill_router.py" --host agy hook' || true

PostInvocation.command: bash -c 'r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && exec bash "$r/with_jev_key.sh" python3 "$r/compact_advisor.py" hook agy' || true

hooks.command: bash -c 'r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && SCOPE_SENTINEL=1 exec bash "$r/with_jev_key.sh" python3 "$r/scope_sentinel.py" hook agy' || true
